programmes.programName: PhD in Industrial and Systems Engineering
programmes.school: Thomas J. Watson College of Engineering and Applied Science
programmes.evidence: Official PhD paragraph names supply chain management, healthcare systems, enterprise systems, optimization and electronics manufacturing research. Dissertation, comprehensive examination and oral defense required. Programme hosted by the School of Systems Science and Industrial Engineering within Watson College.
limitations: One ISE research doctorate; online and campus delivery are not separate awards. Named topics are research areas, not separately awarded concentrations.

branches.conclusion: Full School of Management graduate inventory and all four Management PhD specializations read. Current separate Operations/Supply Chain Management faculty research area does not establish an Operations doctoral specialization.

Full seven-PhD college inventory and the ISE, Systems Science and Mechanical Engineering programme fields read. ISE route verified. Systems Science methods and broad health/decision labels retained as examined candidate without a second eligible route pending explicit operational research context.

Entire current college graduate inventory read: seven PhDs in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial and Systems Engineering, Systems Science. Actual SSIE grouping and full college name verified.
Full graduate overview read: Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science and Engineering MS/PhD awards, four graduate specializations.

All four specialization descriptions read. Manufacturing and Materials concerns additive manufacturing, characterization, microstructure, fabrication and processing; mechanical design optimization not converted into operations research. Dynamic courses partially loading and not used to establish doctoral fields.
